summary_en: Amateur choir of the Austrian-German Society that rehearses on Wednesday evenings in the society's rooms in Marienfelde. It sings mainly Austrian songs, with a focus on Carinthian music.

name: Friedenauer Kantorei
instruments_detail: oratorios, passions and cantatas from the Baroque to the modern era
summary_en: Mixed church choir of about 90 singers at the Zum Guten Hirten parish in Friedenau, rehearsing on Thursday evenings. It performs large oratorios and passions, and new singers join after a short audition.

name: Kantorei Tempelhof
summary_en: Church choir of two Protestant parishes in Tempelhof, rehearsing at the Kirche auf dem Tempelhofer Feld. It sings sacred music from the Baroque to the 20th century and welcomes new singers.

name: Knabenchor Berlin e.V.
summary_en: Boys' and men's choir that rehearses at a primary school in Friedenau and offers basic musical training and singing lessons in small groups. Concerts range from oratorios to musicals.

name: Lichtenrader Chor e.V.
summary_en: Amateur choir in Lichtenrade rehearsing every Monday evening at the Gemeinschaftshaus Lichtenrade. It is looking for singers in all voice parts.

name: MÄNNER-MINNE Schwuler Männerchor Berlin
instruments_detail: male choir with choreography, repertoire from classical to musical and pop
summary_en: Gay men's choir of about 35 singers that rehearses on Monday evenings at the Zwölf-Apostel-Kirche parish hall. It also looks for instrumentalists to accompany the choir.

name: Schöneberger Klangkörper e.V.
summary_en: Mixed crossover choir founded in 1995 that rehearses on Thursday evenings at the Rathaus Schöneberg and is a course of the Musikschule Leo Kestenberg. Currently seeking tenors and basses.

name: Eckener-Gymnasium
summary_en: State secondary school in Mariendorf with a school orchestra, a string club, a wind ensemble and band classes run with the district music school. Instrument lessons for strings, saxophone and clarinet are given in the afternoon.

name: Leo Kestenberg Musikschule Tempelhof-Schöneberg

contract.evidence: E9b/E10 TV Musikschullehrkräfte Land Berlin (closed 2026 postings of the Tempelhof-Schöneberg music school)

conditions.requirements: The 2026 ads ask for an equivalent degree (anabin or ZAB for foreign degrees). AV MuS-Honorare expires on 31.12.2026: 2027 conditions yet to be published.

summary_en: District music school with a strings department (violin, viola) and an orchestra school. No open string post found; the strings head is the contact for freelance (Honorar) applications.

name: Piano Insel Berlin

offer.title: Stellenausschreibungen: piano teachers wanted

contract.evidence: faire Vergütung auf Honorarbasis

conditions.requirements: Completed piano degree, stage experience, good German (English and other languages an advantage).

summary_en: Piano-only studio in Schöneberg that invites qualified piano teachers to apply, paid on a fee basis. Applications go through the website form.

name: B&B Musikschule Berlin

conditions.requirements: The website says the partners teach and that freelance teachers use the rooms; it does not publish conditions for teaching staff.

summary_en: Small private music school in Schöneberg teaching violin and viola, with freelance teachers using its rooms. No job page; speculative application possible.

name: Deutsch-Türkische Musikakademie gGmbH

conditions.requirements: Does not publish conditions for teaching staff.

summary_en: Non-profit music academy in Schöneberg offering violin in Western and classical Turkish style, with English-speaking violin teachers. No job page found.

name: Internationale Musikschule Berlin
summary_en: Private international music school with lessons in piano, guitar, violin, cello, recorder, flute and voice, plus early music education. No teacher recruitment page found.

name: STREICHERKLASSEN punkt BERLIN

conditions.requirements: Does not publish conditions for teaching staff.

summary_en: Private string-only music school in Schöneberg teaching violin, viola, cello and double bass in a mixed string orchestra. No job page; speculative application possible.

name: simplay Musikschule

conditions.requirements: The website highlights professionally trained and certified teaching staff.

summary_en: Certified private music school in Friedenau with three sites, offering violin and viola and string ensembles. No job page found; send a speculative application.

name: Friedenauer Posaunenchor
summary_en: Church brass choir of the Zum Guten Hirten parish in Friedenau, rehearsing on Tuesday evenings. It looks for beginners of all ages who want to learn trumpet, horn, trombone or tuba.

name: Berolina Chorensemble Köpenick e.V.
summary_en: Choir that rehearses on Tuesday evenings in the Kiezklub Bohnsdorf and gives three concerts a year in Köpenick. The site looks for more singers and offers trial rehearsals.

name: Chorensemble Köpenick e.V.
summary_en: Member choir of the Chorverband Berlin with 21 singers and almost 50 years of tradition. Its repertoire runs from classical and sacred music to opera, operetta and musicals.

name: Chorgemeinschaft pro musica Treptow e.V.
summary_en: Senior choir that rehearses on Monday mornings in a room of the Joseph-Schmidt-Musikschule and sings Advent concerts in the Rathaus Treptow.

name: Die Weltberliner (choir)
summary_en: Mixed choir of the KungerKiezInitiative that sings songs from many countries and centuries and rehearses on Monday evenings. It is currently looking for tenors and basses.

name: Déjà-Ouï PopChor
summary_en: Pop choir of about 40 singers from Schöneweide, founded in 2012, that arranges pop songs for a cappella singing. Rehearsals are on Monday evenings.

name: Ev. Kirchengemeinde Friedrichshagen: Kirchenmusik (Christophoruskirche)
summary_en: Parish music in Friedrichshagen with a Kantorei, a chamber choir, a children's and a youth Kantorei, a wind ensemble and a flute circle. The page invites newcomers to join rehearsals.
instruments_detail: choir singing (Kantorei, chamber choir, children's and youth choirs)

name: Ev. Kirchengemeinde Johannisthal: Kirchenmusik (Kantorei, Posaunenchor, Flötenkreis)
summary_en: Parish church music in Johannisthal with a Kantorei, a Gemeindechor, a Posaunenchor, a flute circle and an instrumental circle. The Kantor post was filled in September 2026; the Posaunenchor welcomes new players.

name: Gemischter Chor Berlin-Altglienicke
summary_en: Mixed choir that rehearses on Monday evenings in the Bürgerhaus Altglienicke. The site invites new singers in all voice parts to come to a trial rehearsal.

name: JoCHOR Johannisthal
summary_en: Mixed a cappella choir of about 40 singers in Johannisthal that sings in many languages and gives two large concerts a year. The site announces an open rehearsal.

name: Kammerchor Sing! Sing!
summary_en: Chamber choir that rehearses every Thursday evening in the Christuskirche in Oberschöneweide. The site lists concerts for 2026 and 2027.

name: Männerchor Köpenick - Cöpenicker Liedertafel 1875 e.V.
summary_en: One of the oldest male choirs in Berlin, with about 20 singers and a member of the Chorverband Berlin. It rehearses on Tuesday evenings in the Haus der Begegnung.

name: St. Laurentius-Kantorei Köpenick (Stadtkirche)
summary_en: Kantorei of the Evangelische Stadtkirchengemeinde Köpenick with about 60 singers, one of the largest oratorio choirs in south-east Berlin, plus a children's and youth choir of 40 to 50 children.

name: Evangelische Schule Köpenick (Gymnasium)
summary_en: Protestant Gymnasium with an extended music curriculum and a singing class (Singklasse) in grades 5 and 6 with joint choir work. It also stages school musicals and band evenings.

name: Joseph-Schmidt-Musikschule Treptow-Köpenick

contract.evidence: In Treptow-Köpenick werden zum 1. September Lehrkräfte im Umfang von 3,75 VZÄ angestellt. Weitere Festanstellungen folgen. (Drucksache 19/26581)

conditions.pay: 34,85 (with full qualification) / 32,20 (without) per instrument class; permanent post TV Musikschullehrkräfte, EG 9 or EG 10
conditions.requirements: The call for Musikschullehrkraft Streichinstrumente (Karriereportal, deadline 28.5/28.6.2026) is closed (HTTP 410). The AV MuS-Honorare expires on 31.12.2026: 2027 conditions yet to be published.

summary_en: District music school with a string department (violin, viola, cello, bass) and four orchestras across three sites. The 2026 string-teacher call has closed; more permanent posts are announced.

name: Landesmusikakademie Berlin (im FEZ-Berlin)
summary_en: State music academy on the FEZ campus in the Wuhlheide, running courses, workshops and school music project days. Only a volunteer post is advertised.

name: Musikschule Klangkunst (Berlin Schöneweide)

conditions.requirements: 'eine qualifizierte Ausbildung' or being in music training; Kurzbewerbung by email. No rate published.

summary_en: Private music school (Potsdam, Berlin Schöneweide) currently seeking violin teachers on a fee basis. Short application by email.

name: Vivace Musikakademie
summary_en: Private music academy in Niederschöneweide offering individual violin lessons among other instruments. No job page; speculative application only.

name: freie schule für musik (fsfm)
summary_en: Private music school with branches in Johannisthal and Friedrichshagen, teaching orchestral instruments among others. No job page; a speculative application is the only route.
